role: Renders an EntityBat: the bat model at 0.35 scale with the hanging pose (upside down, folded wings) or the flying pose with flapping wings.
scope_reason: Bats spawn in gated worlds and the mob render scenes compare their pixels.

members.name: renderedBatSize
members.note: vanilla cache that swaps the model when the bat's size flag changes; the native model is stateless per draw

members.name: RenderBat
members.note: model construction; the native model is built per draw in model_bat

members.name: doRender
members.note: the whole bat draw (body, wings, wing membranes) is model_bat, drawn through raster_mobs_draw

members.name: getEntityTexture
members.note: TEX_BAT selection in the draw dispatch

members.name: preRenderCallback
members.note: the 0.35 scale is applied in the shared vertex transform (raster_mobs.c 'if (e->kind == MOB_BAT)' branch)

members.name: renderLivingAt
members.note: the hanging offset is folded into model_bat's root part position

members.name: rotateCorpse
members.note: the pitch/yaw/roll for hanging vs flying is the root part's angles in model_bat

members.name: handleRotationFloat
members.note: RenderLiving's default; the bat wing flap uses age + partialTick directly in model_bat

notes: The flying wing-flap angle (cos(age * 1.3) * PI * 0.25) and the hanging pose are both in model_bat (raster_mobs.c:330). The four bat scenes under out/java/render/ gate both poses through the pixel budget.
